name: shop-performance-tests
description: Performance test platform: k6 load, stress, spike and soak tests for a shop API, with SLO thresholds, baseline regression detection, HTML reports, Grafana dashboards and CI.

scripts.perf:load: mkdir -p reports && K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=reports/load-dashboard.html k6 run --no-usage-report k6/tests/load.js
scripts.perf:stress: mkdir -p reports && K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=reports/stress-dashboard.html k6 run --no-usage-report k6/tests/stress.js
scripts.perf:load:grafana: mkdir -p reports && k6 run --no-usage-report --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 k6/tests/load.js
